status: post-readback directional coefficient contrast fixed before endpoint
question: Using all direction-eligible pairs, is the rainfall-contrast slope of local-memory targeting stronger when the target survey is the wetter member than when the target is the drier member?
source_definition: Mirror exactly NAAMP_PRIOR_SITE_MEMORY_OPPORTUNITY_V0_1 using only eligible runs strictly before the earlier focal-pair year.

directional_models.wet_target: Candidate species were previously known from the route but absent from the focal dry route; response is CI3 rate at prior-same-SiteID candidates minus route-only candidates in the wet survey.
directional_models.dry_target: Exact mirror: candidate species previously known from the route but absent from the focal wet route; response is CI3 rate difference in the dry survey.
directional_models.formula: rate_difference ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber
directional_models.estimator: Weighted least squares using n_same*n_route_only/(n_same+n_route_only); base-model covariance clustered by State:RouteNumber.

primary_contrast.bootstrap: Resample State:RouteNumber clusters with replacement, independently preserving all rows for sampled clusters in both direction datasets; 1000 replicates, seed 2840223.
primary_contrast.rule: Support rain-selective memory if observed difference >0 and percentile bootstrap 95% CI is entirely >0.

gate: Each directional dataset must contain >=750 pairs and >=200 routes.
secondary: Report each directional beta with cluster-robust 95% CI.
Repeat coefficient contrast for CI2plus rate difference using the identical opportunity definition.
Report same-observer directional betas descriptively if both directions retain >=500 pairs and >=150 routes; no extra gate.
interpretation: A positive forward-minus-reverse contrast supports rain-specific selective reactivation beyond generic site recurrence.
Failure means local memory is robust but its selective amplification by rainfall is not demonstrated.
No continuous occupancy, biological memory, individual fidelity, or causal rainfall effect is proven.
